checkScript:
ruby -EUTF-8 <<'RUBY'
require 'yaml'; require 'json'; require 'date'; require 'uri'; require 'digest'
m='.planning/milestones/M001'
docs=[m+'/implementation/frontend-cr034-breakpoint-validation.md',m+'/implementation/frontend-validation.md',m+'/handoffs/frontend-implementation.md']
links=0
docs.each do |file|
  meta=YAML.safe_load(File.read(file),permitted_classes:[Date,Time])
  raise "frontmatter #{file}" unless meta.values_at('milestone','stage','role','agent_name','status')==['M001','implementation','frontend-implementer/base','frontend-claire','awaiting_user_review']
  File.read(file).scan(/\]\(([^)]+)\)/).flatten.each do |link|
    next if link.match?(%r{\A(?:https?://|#)})
    path=File.expand_path(URI::DEFAULT_PARSER.unescape(link.split('#').first),File.dirname(file))
    raise "missing #{link}" unless File.exist?(path)
    links+=1
  end
end
raise 'plan' unless YAML.safe_load(File.read(m+'/implementation/frontend-cr034-breakpoint-worktree-plan.md'),permitted_classes:[Date,Time])['status']=='completed'
%w[029 030 031 032 033 034].each{|x| raise "CR #{x}" unless YAML.safe_load(File.read(m+"/changes/CR-#{x}.md"),permitted_classes:[Date,Time])['status']=='open'}
state=YAML.safe_load(File.read('.planning/workflow/state.yaml'))
raise 'workflow' unless state.values_at('stage','active_agent','status')==['implementation','frontend-claire','active'] && state['last_transition']['decision_id']=='TRANSITION-M001-071'
baseline=JSON.parse(File.read(m+'/implementation/evidence/cr034-071/source-baseline.json'))['hashes']
sources=IO.popen(['rg','--files','frontend','backend','nginx'],&:read).lines.map(&:strip).reject{|x|x.match?(%r{(^|/)\.env(?:\.|$)})}
raise 'new source' unless (sources-baseline.keys).empty?
scope=JSON.parse(File.read(m+'/implementation/evidence/cr034-071/source-scope-check.json'))
raise 'scope' unless scope['verdict']=='PASS'
j=JSON.parse(File.read(m+'/implementation/evidence/cr034-071/development-command-results.json'))
raise 'job result' unless j['jobs'].all?{|x|x['exit_code']==(x['label']=='interactions' ? 1 : 0)}
s=JSON.parse(File.read(m+'/implementation/evidence/cr034-071/cleanup.json'))
raise 'cleanup' unless s['uatUnchanged'] && s['counts'].values_at('generationRuns','credentials')==['0','0']
puts JSON.generate({status:'PASS',documents:docs.size,localLinks:links,existingSourceFiles:sources.size,newProductionFiles:0,openChanges:(29..34).map{|x|"CR-0#{x}"},state:state.values_at('stage','active_agent','status'),transition:state['last_transition']['decision_id'],uatUnchanged:s['uatUnchanged'],initialKnownFailurePreserved:true})
RUBY
